notes: Combined the normal and green terminal variants into one skin with a Theme setting (Terminal, Terminal green, Amber).
Follow app theme still overrides the selected terminal palette.
Designed settings form for theme, branding, search, sidebar width, and color overrides.
Pages that load after the skin now attach to the terminal page area (fixes hieroglyphs and later plugin sections).
Page sections fill the terminal page area instead of assuming the old top-bar height, with an outer scroll fallback.
Sky fills the terminal page area and sizes its sky square for the sidebar-adjusted width.
Top-bar widgets such as the music player stay in the top bar instead of being pushed into the sidebar menu.
Widgets wrap onto their own row on very narrow screens so they cannot break the breadcrumb bar.
New terminal layout: fixed left index with grouped, searchable navigation and counts, thin breadcrumb bar, and an off-canvas drawer on narrow screens.
Terminal palette by default, with followTheme and per-color config overrides.
Reads the live menu, so Menu Order reordering, grouping, and hidden entries are honored.
